points.description: States that h shatters A if, for every possible labeling of the points in A (all 2^N positive/negative assignments), h can classify them correctly, i.e. separate positives from negatives with no error.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only partly stated: e.g. h separates positives from negatives without error but 'all possible labelings' is missing, or all labelings is mentioned but the no-error separation is vague.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying that, for every possible labeling (2^N) of the dataset, the hypothesis can separate positive from negative points with no error, in any wording. Give 1 mark if only one half is clear (no-error separation, or all labelings) or the wording is vague. Give 0 if the answer is unrelated or contradicts the idea (e.g. only one labeling is classified correctly).
